editor.enableEndpoint: Include this endpoint when the node is published
editor.priorityHint: Lower values appear earlier in subscription configurations.
editor.publishHint: Use Overview to publish or pause this node.
editor.requireFormats: Require all three client formats before publishing
editor.requireFormatsTip: Standard protocols (VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, Hysteria2) automatically serve all 3 client formats from 1 server instance. Enable this only if you want to block publishing protocols with partial client support such as TUIC, AnyTLS, or NaiveProxy.
editor.setupHint: A new node starts unpublished. Connect the agent, configure a runtime, then publish endpoints to subscribers.
endpoint.formatUnsupported: {core} does not support this protocol via guided setup. Add a native override if needed.
endpoint.listenerPreset: Protocol and port are filled from the listener. Enter the public address clients will use.
endpoint.nativeHint: Use a core’s native configuration for custom protocols such as WireGuard. Each override takes priority for its own client format.
endpoint.nativeSyntax: Use one key per client format, with a section and config.
endpoint.partial: The listed clients support these settings. Add a native override to supply a different configuration for another format.
endpoint.requiredServerNameHint: Enter the DNS name clients should expect during the TLS handshake.
endpoint.serverKeyHint: Use the Base64 key configured on the matching Shadowsocks 2022 listener.
endpoint.serverNameHint: Enter the DNS name expected by the client. Leave blank for a listener without TLS.
listener.addressHint: Use an address assigned to the node.
listener.coreFixed: The runtime is fixed for an existing instance.
listener.coreHint: Choose the binary that will run on this host.
listener.fileHint: Enter an absolute path on the node.
listener.guideSwitchHint: Saving guided setup applies the listener shown here. Use the native configuration tab to save your original configuration.
listener.nativeHint: Board expands account placeholders when deploying the native settings.
listener.objectRequired: Configuration must be a JSON object.
listener.pemHint: The node receives the certificate and key over its encrypted control connection.
listener.portHint: Use a port available on the node.
listener.serverKeyHint: Use the same Base64 key in the client endpoint. Board assigns separate credentials to each subscriber.
meter.accountHint: Use the dedicated subscriber’s runtime identifier.
meter.guidedHint: The listener will expose the configured statistics API. Verify collection with live traffic after deployment.
meter.mihomoHint: Dedicated metering attributes the whole instance to one account.
meter.nativeHint: The native configuration must expose the matching statistics API.
meter.saved: Metering settings added to the configuration. Save the instance and check for usage reports after running traffic.
meter.singboxHint: Per-user metering requires a build that includes the V2Ray statistics API.
meter.xrayHint: Xray reports transfer for accounts named in its native configuration.
obfsHint: Leave blank when the server uses the default transport.
